verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently — intake pipeline needs to convert them.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 124 leads at $11.43 cost per lead, entirely through Meta — no Google Ads activity ran this period. Spend pulled back sharply in the most recent week (down roughly 49%), but your cost per lead actually improved 32% over that same stretch, meaning the remaining budget is converting more efficiently than before. The concern right now is further down the funnel: 85 opportunities were opened in your pipeline over the last 28 days, but none converted to appointments or closed business — that points to an intake or follow-up issue, not an ads problem. Conversion tracking is being repaired so that the August scorecard reflects accurate patient outcomes; expect that to be resolved by month-end. Once attribution is clean, you'll have a reliable read on which leads are turning into scheduled patients.
